takes.p: Josh Malerman's Pictures of You was published by Del Rey on September 8. Emily wakes in an unfamiliar room where a menacing woman treats her as an artist's model, and her boyfriend Jack's life is in danger, according to Bookreporter.

takes.h: Craig Zobel to direct Something Is Killing the Children
takes.p: Dread Central reports that Craig Zobel will direct a feature adaptation of Something Is Killing the Children for Blumhouse.

takes.h: NECA shows Jason figures from Parts 8 and 9
takes.p: At New York Toy Fair 2026, NECA showed figures from Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan and Jason Goes to Hell. Mad About Horror's roundup of the NECA reveals gives no release timing for either.

takes.h: Trick or Treat Studios lists new masks
takes.p: Trick or Treat Studios' new-arrivals feed lists a C.H.U.D. Underground Dweller mask (October 2), a Don Post DK mask (October 1) and Haunt Zombie, Witch, Vampire and Ghost masks (September 25).
